# Video Cut (by CodeLove)

> Free in-browser video shorts cutter & online video splitter — cut videos into equal parts or 9:16 vertical Shorts/Reels with blur fill, multi-audio track selection, and instant ZIP export.

## Pages
- [Video Cut Studio](https://videocut.codelove.in/): Main browser video cutter & equal-parts splitter.
- [Video Shorts Cutter](https://videocut.codelove.in/video-shorts-cutter/): Cut horizontal videos into 15s, 30s, or 60s 9:16 vertical Shorts & Reels.
- [Video Cutter](https://videocut.codelove.in/video-cutter/): Fast lossless video splitter with multi-language audio selection and ZIP download.
